SELECT customers.Segment, yearmonth.Consumption FROM customers JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID WHERE yearmonth.Date LIKE '2012%' AND yearmonth.Date LIKE '2013%' ORDER BY Consumption DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT Segment, SUM(Consumption) AS "2013_Consumption_EUR", SUM(Consumption) - LAG(SUM(Consumption), 1) AS "Increase_or_Decrease_EUR", (SUM(Consumption) - LAG(SUM(Consumption), 1) / SUM(Consumption) * 100) AS "Percentage_of_Increase"
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date LIKE '2013%'
GROUP BY Segment
ORDER BY Percentage_of_Increase DESC, Increase_or_Decrease_EUR DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    Segment,
    SUM(Consumption) AS Increase_in_EUR,
    (SUM(Consumption) / SUM(Consumption) OVER(PARTITION BY Segment)) * 100 AS Percentage_of_Increase
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', ym.Date) = '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y', ym.Date) = '2012'
)
GROUP BY Segment
ORDER BY Percentage_of_Increase DESC, Increase_in_EUR DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT Segment, MAX(Consumption) AS MaxConsumption, MIN(Consumption) AS MinConsumption
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    ym.Consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
)
GROUP BY Segment;

SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(milliseconds, 1, 3) AS REAL)) AS avg_time_seconds FROM results WHERE year < 1975 AND time IS NOT NULL AND driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM drivers) GROUP BY year;

SELECT 
    r.year,
    CAST(SUBSTR(t.time, 0, 2) * 3600 + SUBSTR(t.time, 3, 2) * 60 + SUBSTR(t.time, 6, 2)) AS time_in_seconds
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    lapTimes t ON r.resultId = t.raceId
WHERE 
    r.position = 1 AND t.time IS NOT NULL AND r.year < 1975;

SELECT 
    r.year,
    AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(t.time, 0, 2) * 3600 + SUBSTR(t.time, 3, 2) * 60 + SUBSTR(t.time, 6, 2) AS REAL) / 3600) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM 
    races r
JOIN 
    results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN 
    lapTimes t ON res.driverId = t.driverId
WHERE 
    r.year < 1975 AND t.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY

WITH ShortestLap AS (
    SELECT
        drivers.forename,
        drivers.surname,
        lapTimes.time,
        MIN(STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(lapTimes.time))) AS shortest_lap_time
    FROM
        lapTimes
    JOIN
        drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId
    GROUP BY
        drivers.forename,
        drivers.surname,
        lapTimes.time
    HAVING
        MIN(STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(lapTimes.time))) = (
            SELECT MIN(STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(time))) FROM lapTimes
        )
)
SELECT
    forename,
    surname
FROM
    ShortestLap
WHERE
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(shortest_lap_time)) ASC) <= 20;

SELECT (subtract(time, champion_time) / last_driver_time) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM (
  SELECT
    time,
    last_driver_time,
    champion_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      lap_times.time AS time,
      results.time AS last_driver_time,
      (
        SELECT time
        FROM lap_times, results
        WHERE lap_times.driverId = results.driverId
          AND results.position = (
            SELECT MAX(position)
            FROM lap_times
            WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix')
          )
      ) AS champion_time
    FROM lap_times
    JOIN results ON lap_times.driverId = results.driverId
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix')
  )
)

SELECT (divide(subtract(str_to_time(last_driver_time), str_to_time(champion_time)), str_to_time(last_driver_time)) * 100) AS percentage_difference FROM (SELECT d.time AS champion_time, l.time AS last_driver_time FROM drivers d JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId JOIN races a ON r.raceId = a.raceId WHERE a.name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1) AS champion_times, (SELECT d.time AS last_driver_time FROM drivers d JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId JOIN races a ON r.raceId = a.raceId WHERE a.name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix' AND r.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix'))) AS last_driver_times;

SELECT (subtract(time, champion_time) / last_driver_time) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM (
  SELECT
    time AS last_driver_time,
    (SELECT time FROM lap_times WHERE raceId = 10 AND position = 1) AS champion_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      time,
      (SELECT position FROM results WHERE raceId = 10 AND position = 1) AS position
    FROM lap_times
    WHERE raceId = 10 AND time IS NOT NULL
  ) AS last_driver,
  (SELECT time FROM lap_times WHERE raceId = 10 AND position = 1) AS champion_time
) AS subquery
WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix');

WITH RECURSIVE ChampionTime AS (
    SELECT time AS champion_time
    FROM lap_times
    JOIN results ON lap_times.driverId = results.driverId
    JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
    WHERE races.name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix' AND position = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time, champion_time
    FROM lap_times
    JOIN results ON lap_times.driverId = results.driverId
    JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
    JOIN ChampionTime ON 1 = 1
    WHERE races.name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix' AND position < (SELECT MAX(position) FROM ChampionTime)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT time FROM ChampionTime WHERE position = 1) - (SELECT time FROM ChampionTime WHERE position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM ChampionTime)) * 100 / (SELECT time FROM ChampionTime WHERE position = (SELECT MIN(position) FROM ChampionTime)) AS percentage_faster
FROM ChampionTime
WHERE position IN (1, (SELECT MAX(position) FROM ChampionTime));

SELECT 
    t1.account_id,
    t1.A11 AS lowest_avg_salary,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM financial.district t2 JOIN financial.client t3 ON t2.district_id = t3.district_id WHERE t3.gender = 'F') - t1.A11 AS gap
FROM 
    financial.client t1
WHERE 
    t1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY 
    t1.birth_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.account_id FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC, a.A11 ASC LIMIT 1; SELECT MAX(a.A11) FROM account a; CALCULATE (MAX(a.A11) - MIN(a.A11)) AS Gap;

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    a.account_id,
    MAX(d.A11) - MIN(d.A11) AS Gap
FROM
    client c
JOIN
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY
    c.client_id
ORDER BY
    MAX(d.A11) ASC,
    MIN(d.A11) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH oldest_female_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F'
  ORDER BY birthdate ASC
  LIMIT 1
), lowest_avg_salary_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(A11) AS min_avg_salary
  FROM district
  JOIN client ON district.client_id = client.client_id
  WHERE gender = 'F'
  GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT A11 FROM district WHERE client_id = lowest_avg_salary_clients.client_id) AS lowest_avg_salary,
  (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) AS highest_avg_salary,
  (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT A11 FROM district WHERE client_id = lowest_avg_salary_clients.client_id) AS gap
FROM oldest_female_clients
JOIN lowest_avg_salary_clients ON oldest_female_clients.client_id = lowest_avg_salary_clients.client_id;

SELECT DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN older_than_55 AND PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN older_than_55 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55 THEN 'older_than_55'
      ELSE 'not_older_than_55'
    END AS older_than_55,
    CASE 
      WHEN PT >= 14 THEN 'PT_abnormal'
      ELSE 'PT_normal'
    END AS PT_status
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE PT IS NOT NULL
) subquery;

SELECT DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN older_than_55 AND PT >= 14 AND sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN older_than_55 AND PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 as percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55 THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS older_than_55,
    PT >= 14 AS abnormal_PT,
    sex = 'F' AS sex
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
) subquery;

SELECT DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN older_than_55 AND sex = 'F' AND PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN older_than_55 AND PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55 THEN TRUE 
      ELSE FALSE 
    END AS older_than_55,
    SEX,
    PT > = 14 AS abnormal_PT
  FROM Patient
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
      SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) AS age_diff,
      SEX,
      PT
    FROM Patient
    CROSS JOIN (
      SELECT 
        CURRENT_DATE AS current_timestamp,
        Birthday
    FROM Patient
  )
  WHERE age_diff > 55
) subquery;

SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS element_count
  FROM atom
  JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
  JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
  WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY molecule_id
)

This query calculates the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules by first counting the distinct oxygen atoms in each molecule that have single bonds (bond_type = '-'), and then averaging those counts.

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.NCESSchool,
        s.SOCType,
        AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.cname ORDER BY AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) DESC) AS Rank
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.NCESSchool, s.SOCType, ss.cname
)
SELECT CDSCode, NCESSchool, SOCType
FROM RankedSchools
WHERE Rank <= 5;

SELECT s.SchoolName
FROM schools s
JOIN "frpm" f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.rtype = 'D'
AND (ss.AvgScrRead, ss.County) IN (
    SELECT ss2.AvgScrRead, ss2.County
    FROM schools ss2
    JOIN "frpm" f2 ON ss2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
    JOIN satscores ss2 ON ss2.CDSCode = ss2.cds
    GROUP BY ss2.County
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 5
)
ORDER BY ss.County, ss.AvgScrRead DESC;

SELECT County, SchoolName, AvgReadingScore FROM (SELECT s.County, s.SchoolName, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) as AvgReadingScore FROM schools s JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.SchoolName) subquery ORDER BY County, AvgReadingScore DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT s.NCESSchool, s.SOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, CountyCode, AVG(AvgScrRead) as AvgReadingScore
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools sch ON satscores.cds = sch.CDSCode
    GROUP BY cds, CountyCode
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrRead) >= (
        SELECT AVG(AvgScrRead)
        FROM satscores s2
        JOIN schools sch2 ON s2.cds = sch2.CDSCode
        WHERE sch2.Virtual = 'F' AND sch2.CountyCode = sch.CountyCode
    )
) ranked_schools ON sch.CDSCode = ranked_schools.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY s.NCESSchool, s.SOCType
HAVING COUNT(s.NCESSchool) <= 5;
